model: iQ500 series, likely SN658D01NG or similar (exact model on the rating plate on the door edge)
intro_native: This is a Siemens built-in dishwasher, probably from the iQ500 range. The buttons sit on the top edge of the door, so you only see them with the door open. Let's run a normal everyday wash together.
intro_en: This is a Siemens built-in dishwasher, probably from the iQ500 range. The buttons sit on the top edge of the door, so you only see them with the door open. Let's run a normal everyday wash together.

buttons.function_native: Turns the dishwasher on or off.
buttons.function_en: Turns the dishwasher on or off.

buttons.function_native: For very dirty pots and pans.
buttons.function_en: For very dirty pots and pans.

buttons.function_native: The machine senses how dirty the dishes are and adjusts the wash.
buttons.function_en: The machine senses how dirty the dishes are and adjusts the wash.

buttons.function_native: Saves the most energy and water for normal loads. Takes longer.
buttons.function_en: Saves the most energy and water for normal loads. Takes longer.

buttons.function_native: A quiet wash, good for night time.
buttons.function_en: A quiet wash, good for night time.

buttons.function_native: A gentle wash for glasses and delicate items.
buttons.function_en: A gentle wash for glasses and delicate items.

buttons.function_native: Cleans a normal load in about one hour.
buttons.function_en: Cleans a normal load in about one hour.

buttons.function_native: A short wash for lightly dirty dishes.
buttons.function_en: A short wash for lightly dirty dishes.

buttons.function_native: Tap for a quick cold rinse. Hold 3 seconds to open settings like water hardness.
buttons.function_en: Tap for a quick cold rinse. Hold 3 seconds to open settings like water hardness.

buttons.function_native: Sets a later start time in hours. Also changes values in settings.
buttons.function_en: Sets a later start time in hours. Also changes values in settings.

buttons.function_native: Probably gives the lower basket a stronger wash.
buttons.function_en: Probably gives the lower basket a stronger wash.

buttons.function_native: Makes the wash shorter, but uses more energy and water.
buttons.function_en: Makes the wash shorter, but uses more energy and water.

buttons.function_native: Lights up when rinse aid needs topping up.
buttons.function_en: Lights up when rinse aid needs topping up.

buttons.function_native: Lights up when dishwasher salt is low.
buttons.function_en: Lights up when dishwasher salt is low.

buttons.function_native: Probably lights up if water isn't coming in.
buttons.function_en: Probably lights up if water isn't coming in.

buttons.function_native: Tap to start. Hold about 3 seconds to cancel.
buttons.function_en: Tap to start. Hold about 3 seconds to cancel.

steps.narration_native: First, put your dishes in the baskets. Make sure nothing stops the spray arms from turning. Keep big items away from the little detergent flap on the door.
steps.narration_en: First, put your dishes in the baskets. Make sure nothing stops the spray arms from turning. Keep big items away from the little detergent flap on the door.

steps.narration_native: Find the detergent box on the inside of the door. Put in one tab or some powder. Then close the lid until it clicks.
steps.narration_en: Find the detergent box on the inside of the door. Put in one tab or some powder. Then close the lid until it clicks.

steps.narration_native: Look at the black strip on the top edge of the door. On the left, just after the Siemens name, is a small circle with a line. Press it to switch the machine on.
steps.narration_en: Look at the black strip on the top edge of the door. On the left, just after the Siemens name, is a small circle with a line. Press it to switch the machine on.

steps.narration_native: Now choose a programme. Press the button marked Eco 50°, the third one in the row. It's the best choice for everyday dishes. If you're not sure how dirty they are, Auto, just to its left, works well too.
steps.narration_en: Now choose a programme. Press the button marked Eco 50°, the third one in the row. It's the best choice for everyday dishes. If you're not sure how dirty they are, Auto, just to its left, works well too.

steps.narration_native: Go to the right side of the strip and press the word Start. Just tap it, don't hold it. Holding it cancels the wash.
steps.narration_en: Go to the right side of the strip and press the word Start. Just tap it, don't hold it. Holding it cancels the wash.

steps.narration_native: Close the door firmly within a few seconds. The wash only runs when the door is shut. That's it, your dishes are washing!
steps.narration_en: Close the door firmly within a few seconds. The wash only runs when the door is shut. That's it, your dishes are washing!

tips.native: To cancel a wash, open the door, hold Start for about 3 seconds, then close the door. The water drains in about a minute.
tips.en: To cancel a wash, open the door, hold Start for about 3 seconds, then close the door. The water drains in about a minute.

tips.native: If nothing happens after Start, check the door is fully shut and the water tap is on.
tips.en: If nothing happens after Start, check the door is fully shut and the water tap is on.

tips.native: When it's finished, let it cool, then empty the bottom basket first so drips from the top don't land on clean dishes.
tips.en: When it's finished, let it cool, then empty the bottom basket first so drips from the top don't land on clean dishes.

tips.native: Top up salt or rinse aid when their lights come on. The salt goes in the container under the bottom basket.
tips.en: Top up salt or rinse aid when their lights come on. The salt goes in the container under the bottom basket.

tips.native: Clean the filters at the bottom of the tub now and then for better results.
tips.en: Clean the filters at the bottom of the tub now and then for better results.

warnings.native: Never put detergent in the salt container. It can ruin the water softener.
warnings.en: Never put detergent in the salt container. It can ruin the water softener.

warnings.native: Keep children away from detergent and the open door. Put knives point-down or flat.
warnings.en: Keep children away from detergent and the open door. Put knives point-down or flat.

warnings.native: For leaks, error codes, or any repair, don't open the machine. Contact Siemens official support or your landlord.
warnings.en: For leaks, error codes, or any repair, don't open the machine. Contact Siemens official support or your landlord.

closing_native: Well done! You've started a normal wash. Next time it's just: load, detergent, power, Eco, Start, and close the door.
closing_en: Well done! You've started a normal wash. Next time it's just: load, detergent, power, Eco, Start, and close the door.
